import pytest
import click

def test_backspace_behavior(runner, monkeypatch):
    @click.command()
    def cli():
        click.prompt("Enter text", default="test")

    monkeypatch.setattr(click._termui_impl, "isatty", lambda _: True)
    result = runner.invoke(cli, input="te\x08st\n")  # Simulate backspace
    assert result.output.strip() == "Enter text: test"
